svg.title: Binder clip — reference-based editable vector
svg.desc: One continuous coated spring sheet, four outer bearing rolls, two returning central lips and two continuous planar wire handles. Body proportions use the clear mouth photograph; the different oblique specimen supplies target pose and complete handle appearance. Normalized construction and approximate camera, not a dimensioned scan. All eleven checked local groups retained in their common coordinates. Artwork by youchibuwan-ops, 2026, CC BY-SA 3.0; reference credits and licensing exceptions are in ATTRIBUTION.md.
